notes_for_editor: Registry-only record. The firelookout.ca entry gives a location and an elevation of 207 m (679 ft), but its tower type, height and year built are all N/A, and it has no photos or comments. The genealogy page supports only the place name Clarks Corners, not the tower. The brief's coordinates match the registry entry, so no correction is proposed. The story is short because two searches found no other record of this tower. The Ontario GeoHub tower dataset named in the brief did not render, so it was not used.
